query: Consider the following context: The recent trend of high-entropy alloys (HEAs) was studied extensively for their promising mechanical properties, but individual constituents' effects have remained unexplored. In that context, which method can be used for the effects of changing the percentage of elements of HfNbTaTiZr-HEA on the mechanical properties, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Changing the percentage of elements in HfNbTaTiZr-HEA will impact its mechanical properties.
generation.intervention: Alteration of the percentage of elements (Hf, Nb, Ta, Ti, Zr) in the alloy
generation.mechanism: Solid solution strengthening and lattice strain
generation.predicted_outcome: Improvement or deterioration in mechanical properties such as strength, hardness, and ductility
generation.baseline: Initial mechanical properties of HfNbTaTiZr-HEA with standard composition
generation.boundary: Limits of solubility and phase stability in the HfNbTaTiZr system
generation.uncertainty: Extent and direction of property changes with specific elemental variations

falsification_experiment.design: Systematic variation of elemental percentages in HfNbTaTiZr-HEA followed by mechanical testing
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If no significant correlation between elemental percentage changes and mechanical property variations is found, the hypothesis is falsified.
